title: Skin cancer prevention: UV-exposure counseling for persons aged 6 months to 24 years with fair skin types

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends counseling young adults, adolescents, children, and parents of young children about minimizing exposure to ultraviolet (UV) radiation for persons aged 6 months to 24 years with fair skin types to reduce their risk of skin cancer.

action: Counsel the patient, or the parent of a young child, about minimizing exposure to ultraviolet (UV) radiation.

derived.min: The text says 6 months, but ages must be whole years. The minimum is set to 1 so infants younger than 6 months are never included; this deliberately leaves out children aged 6-11 months.

uncomputable.needs: Fitzpatrick skin type / fair skin assessment (not reliably held in structured EHR data)

denominator.quote: for persons aged 6 months to 24 years with fair skin types

uncomputable.needs: Documentation that the patient (or the parent of a young child) was counseled about minimizing UV radiation exposure; no counseling interval is stated in the text

numerator.quote: counseling young adults, adolescents, children, and parents of young children about minimizing exposure to ultraviolet (UV) radiation
